## Impact per lever

- **1. Flat-rate task pricing, not hourly** — Inverts the speed incentive. On T&M a fast tech earns you less.
- **2. Raise prices 10% and measure close rate** — +10% price on a 54% margin job is ~20% more gross profit.
- **3. Good / Better / Best on every quote** — Anchors high, shifts the mix up off the cheapest option.
- **4. Two-hour minimum plus trip charge, enforced** — Kills the $90 job that eats a three-hour round trip.
- **5. Paid estimates over $5k, credited on signing** — Filters tire-kickers; payers close at multiples of the rate.
- **6. Maintenance plan on every mini split** — 100 units under contract is $20k+/yr recurring at ~70% margin.
- **7. Hold a 30% materials markup** — $8-15k per tech per year that most shops give away.
- **8. Sell the next job on the current job** — Free 15-25% revenue. Highest-converting source in home services.
- **9. Neighbour blitz after every job** — Raises route density and cuts drive time at the same time.
- **10. Bid the whole punch list, not the one item** — One dispatch, ten line items, no extra drive.
- **11. Be the after-hours provider** — Premium rate, near-zero competition, instant PM loyalty.
- **12. Get formally onto property-manager vendor lists** — Boring paperwork competitors skip; becomes a dispatch queue.
- **13. Free mini split suitability assessment as lead magnet** — High intent, converts hot, puts you inside the house.
- **14. Deposit on every job, e-signed on the spot** — Kills the receivables problem before it exists.
- **15. Same-day invoice, card on file, auto-charge** — 30-day to 3-day DSO on $60k/mo frees ~$54k of working capital.
- **16. Route density rule: 15 minutes between same-day jobs** — 65% to 75% utilization is ~15% more revenue on identical payroll.
- **17. Standardised truck stock, weekly restock** — Supply-house runs cost 45-90 minutes each and are invisible.
- **18. Photo pre-qualification before rolling a truck** — Saves one to two wasted trips per tech per week.
- **19. Batch mini split installs geographically** — Two installs in one neighbourhood shares drive and equipment run.
- **20. Distributor account instead of retail** — 15-30% off equipment: $600-1,100 per multi-zone job.
- **21. Audit workers' comp class codes** — Misclassification quietly costs thousands a year.
- **22. Hire tech #2 before you feel ready** — Tech #1 nets $333/mo. Profit starts at tech #2.
- **23. Fire the worst 10% of customers annually** — Raise their price 30%: they leave or become profitable.
- **24. One config-driven codebase for every trade and metro** — New city is a config file. Competitors pay an agency $3k a site.
- **25. Film every job: 20 photos and one 60-second vertical** — ~400 pieces of proof in twelve months that nobody can replicate.
